verbs.core: 最籠統的「做」：只要說得出是哪件事，幾乎都能用 do；也用來評斷「夠不夠用」「表現好壞」。

m.x: Let me know if there's anything I can do.
m.xz: 有什麼我能幫忙的，儘管說。

m.x: A short walk will do you good.
A sandwich will do for lunch.
m.xz: 午餐吃個三明治就行了。

m.x: The new product did better than expected.
m.xz: 新產品的表現比預期好。

p.x: The ministry plans to do away with paper forms.
p.xz: 部會打算廢除紙本表格。

p.x: They bought an old house and did it up.
p.xz: 他們買下一間老房子，再整修一番。

p.x: I could really do with a holiday.
p.xz: 我真需要放個假。

p.x: We'll have to do without a projector today.
p.xz: 今天只好不用投影機了。

i: 該做與不該做的事・規矩
verbs.tip: 中文的「做」不一定譯成 do：「做決定」是 make a decision、「做研究」是 do research、「做飯」常說 cook 或 make dinner。do 多半搭配工作、作業、家務這類「活動」。

verbs.core: 離開原點往外移動；延伸為「運轉」「消失」「延伸到」「變成（多半變差）」「花掉」。

m.x: We'll go by train and be back by six.
m.xz: 我們搭火車去，六點前回來。

m.x: My appetite has completely gone.
The trail goes up to the summit.
The milk has gone sour.
Half the grant went on equipment.
m.xz: 補助款有一半花在設備上。

p.x: I'll go along with the majority view.
p.xz: 我配合多數人的意見。

p.zh: 變質；（警報）響起；不再喜歡
p.x: The fire alarm went off during the exam.
p.xz: 考試時火災警報突然響了。

p.x: What's going on here?
p.xz: 這裡發生什麼事了？

p.x: Let's go over the main points once more.
p.xz: 我們再把重點過一遍。

p.x: The country went through a deep recession.
p.xz: 這個國家經歷了一場嚴重衰退。

verbs.tip: 「事情進行得如何？」可以說 How did it go?；「一切順利」是 It went well.，比 proceed 口語自然。go + 形容詞多半指變壞：go bad、go bankrupt、go wrong。

verbs.core: 「行動」與「扮演」兩條線：採取行動、表現得像、上台演出，也指在某個位置上發揮作用。

m.x: Don't act the innocent with me.
The government must act before prices rise further.
m.xz: 政府必須在物價繼續上漲前採取行動。

m.x: She acted as if nothing had happened.
m.xz: 她表現得像什麼事都沒發生。

m.x: The deputy acted as chair while she was away.
m.xz: 她不在的時候，由副手代理主席。

p.zh: 不乖・搗蛋；（機器）出毛病
p.x: The printer started acting up just before the meeting.
p.xz: 開會前印表機偏偏出狀況。

i: 表現得符合年紀・別幼稚
verbs.tip: 「代理主任」「代理部長」用 acting：acting director、acting minister。口譯時遇到「代理」「暫代」，先想到 acting，不必說 temporary。

verbs.core: 「再加上去」：數字相加、內容增補；說話時「補充一句」也是 add。

m.x: If you add the shipping fee, it comes to NT$1,200.
m.xz: 加上運費，總共新臺幣一千二百元。

m.x: We've added two new routes this year.
m.xz: 我們今年新增了兩條航線。

m.x: "And it has to be done by Friday," she added.
m.xz: 她補了一句：「而且週五前要完成。」

p.x: The hotel adds on a service charge.
p.xz: 飯店會另加服務費。

p.x: The rain only added to the confusion.
p.xz: 下雨讓場面更混亂。

p.x: His story just doesn't add up.
p.xz: 他的說法根本兜不攏。

verbs.tip: 「我補充一點」說 If I may add… 或 I'd just like to add that…，比 supplement 自然得多。

verbs.core: 「開口」：提問、請求、邀請，連「開價」也是向對方開口要。

m.x: Can I ask you something about the schedule?
m.xz: 我可以問你行程的事嗎？

m.x: They asked us to keep the meeting short.
m.xz: 他們要求我們把會議開短一點。

m.x: We've asked a few colleagues over for dinner.
m.xz: 我們請了幾位同事來家裡吃飯。

m.x: How much are they asking for the flat?
m.xz: 那間公寓他們開價多少？

p.x: I'll ask around and see if anyone knows a good translator.
p.xz: 我到處問問，看有沒有人認識好的譯者。

verbs.tip: 中文「請問」直譯成 Please ask 是常見錯誤，英文用 May I ask…? 或 Could you tell me…?。「要求」不一定要用 demand，demand 語氣很強，一般請求用 ask 就夠了。

verbs.core: 「花錢換來」：購買；延伸為收買人心、接受某種說法、爭取時間。

m.x: We bought the tickets online.
I don't buy his excuse.

p.x: Not everyone buys into the new strategy.
p.xz: 不是每個人都認同新策略。

i: buy a pig in a poke
沒看清楚就買・隔山買牛
verbs.tip: 「爭取時間」說 buy time，比 gain time 道地；「買帳」也能用 buy：They didn't buy it.（他們不買帳。）

verbs.core: 「切開」：刀切、剪斷，延伸為刪減、刪除、裁員、中斷，以及錄製唱片。

m.x: Cut the cake into eight pieces.
The company plans to cut costs by ten percent.
m.xz: 公司打算削減一成成本。

m.x: The editor cut two paragraphs from my article.
m.xz: 編輯刪掉我文章裡的兩段。

p.x: Many families are cutting back on travel.
p.xz: 很多家庭都在縮減旅遊開支。

p.x: Sorry to cut in, but we're running out of time.
p.xz: 抱歉插個話，時間快不夠了。

p.x: We got cut off in the middle of the call.
p.xz: 電話講到一半斷線了。

p.zh: 剪下；戒除；（引擎）熄火；適合

verbs.tip: 「砍預算」「刪減經費」直接用 cut：budget cuts、cut spending，比 reduce 更有力。「長話短說」可以說 Let me cut to the chase.

verbs.core: 「停止」：生命結束、事物消逝、機器停擺；誇張用法表示「想得要命」。

m.x: Her grandfather died at the age of 98.
The tradition is slowly dying.
My phone died halfway through the call.
m.xz: 電話講到一半，手機沒電了。

m.x: I'm dying to know what happened.
m.xz: 我超想知道發生了什麼事。

p.x: The controversy took months to die down.
p.xz: 這場爭議過了幾個月才平息。

verbs.tip: 正式場合提到過世，用 pass away 比較委婉；die 是中性、直接的說法，新聞與書面都常見。「笑死我了」可以說 I nearly died laughing.

verbs.core: 從「沒有」變成「有」：拿到東西、到達地方、進入某種狀態；連「懂」也是把意思拿到手。

m.x: I got your email this morning — thanks.
m.xz: 今天早上收到你的信了，謝謝。

m.x: I've got a meeting at three.
Let me get you a glass of water.
What time did you get to the venue?
Sorry, I don't get the reference.
m.xz: 抱歉，我聽不懂這個典故。

m.x: Can you get the projector working?
m.xz: 你能讓投影機動起來嗎？

m.x: What really gets me is the double standard.
m.xz: 最讓我受不了的是雙重標準。

m.x: We'd better get going.
I've got to finish this by noon.
m.xz: 我中午前得把這個做完。

m.x: The discussion was getting heated.

m.zh: 有機會・得以（get to do）
m.x: I never got to thank her in person.
m.xz: 我一直沒機會當面謝謝她。

m.x: He got stuck in traffic for an hour.
They got into debt within a year.
m.xz: 他們不到一年就負債了。

p.x: We need a simpler way to get the message across.
p.xz: 我們得找個更簡單的方式把訊息講清楚。

p.x: The two delegations got along surprisingly well.
p.xz: 兩國代表團相處得出奇融洽。

p.zh: 到處走動；規避；（消息）傳開
p.x: They found a way to get around the regulations.
p.xz: 他們找到規避法規的辦法。

p.x: What exactly are you getting at?
p.xz: 你到底想暗示什麼？

p.zh: 上車；相處；進展；上了年紀

p.x: It took the party months to get over the defeat.
p.xz: 黨內花了好幾個月才走出敗選陰霾。

p.zh: 讓對方聽進去；（電話）接通

i: get even / get one's own back
verbs.tip: 中文的「取得、獲得」容易讓人直接想到 obtain、acquire；口語場合用 get 更自然，正式書面再換回去。「get + 過去分詞」常用來說遭遇或變化，例如 got stuck（卡住）、got promoted（升職），比「be + 過去分詞」更口語。

verbs.core: 「放行」：允許、讓…去做；let's 用來提議，也指出租房屋。

m.x: Let me know when you arrive.

m.zh: 提議・警告・祝願（let's / let…）
m.x: Let's take a short break.
Let x be the number of participants.
Let me have the final figures when they're ready.
They let the flat to students.

p.x: I promised to help, and I won't let you down.
p.xz: 我答應幫忙，就不會讓你失望。

p.x: The pressure never lets up in this job.
p.xz: 這份工作的壓力從來沒停過。

echo: let sb go in order to catch them later
verbs.tip: 「讓我想想」是 Let me think.；「讓我們歡迎…」是 Let's welcome…。中文的「讓」若是「使得」的意思，多用 make（The news made her cry.），不是 let。

verbs.core: 「付出」：付錢、付代價，也付出注意力與敬意；反過來說，事情「值得」也是 pay。

m.x: Can I pay by card?
Please pay attention to the safety instructions.
The minister paid a visit to the flood area.
m.xz: 部長前往水災災區視察。

m.x: It pays to read the contract carefully.

p.x: I'll pay you back next week.
p.xz: 我下週還你。

p.x: All that preparation finally paid off.
p.xz: 那些準備終於有了回報。

i: 口頭上支持・說說而已
付出高昂代價・花冤枉錢
echo: pay lip service while secretly defying
verbs.tip: 「關注」「留意」說 pay attention to，比 focus on 更常見；「拜訪」「致意」可以說 pay a visit、pay tribute。口譯時遇到「付出代價」，pay the price 最直接。

verbs.core: 把東西「放到某個位置」，再延伸到把想法放進語言（表達）、把數字放上去（估計）、把人放進某種處境。

m.x: Where did you put the signed contract?
m.xz: 簽好的合約你放在哪裡？

m.x: Let me put it another way.
Analysts put the cost at around NT$2 billion.
m.xz: 分析師估計成本約新臺幣二十億元。

m.x: May I put a question to the minister?
m.xz: 我可以向部長提個問題嗎？

m.x: She put years of work into this report.
m.xz: 她為這份報告投入多年心血。

m.x: The scandal put the whole team under pressure.
m.xz: 這起醜聞讓整個團隊承受壓力。

p.x: Let's put our differences aside for now.
p.xz: 我們先把歧見擱在一邊。

p.zh: 寫下；鎮壓；貶低；（動物）安樂死
p.x: Put down your name and email here.
p.xz: 在這裡寫下你的姓名和電子郵件。

p.x: Taiwan put forward three proposals at the meeting.
p.xz: 臺灣在會中提出三項建議。

p.x: The team put in long hours before the launch.
p.xz: 上線前，團隊投入了大量時間。

p.x: The vote has been put off until next week.
p.xz: 表決延到下週。

p.zh: 穿上；打開；舉辦；變胖；假裝

p.x: The ministry put out a statement this morning.
p.xz: 部會今早發布聲明。

p.zh: 轉接（電話）；讓人經歷（苦頭）
p.x: Could you put this call through to the press office?
p.xz: 可以幫我把電話轉到新聞室嗎？

p.x: I can't put up with this noise any longer.
p.xz: 這噪音我再也忍不下去了。

i: put in a good word for sb
要嘛拿出行動，要嘛閉嘴
be hard put to do sth
echo: put a toe in the water
put one's neck on the line
put the pedal to the metal
verbs.tip: 「換句話說」「這麼說好了」的英文常用 put：to put it simply、let me put it another way、how shall I put it。口譯時需要重述或爭取時間，這幾句很好用。

verbs.core: 「快速、持續地移動」：跑、逃，延伸為（車輛）行駛、（機器）運轉、（液體）流動、（道路）延伸、（活動）持續，還有經營與參選。

m.x: She ran to catch the bus.
When the police arrived, the suspects ran.
The shuttle bus runs every twenty minutes.
m.xz: 接駁車每二十分鐘一班。

m.x: Tears were running down her face.
The exhibition runs until the end of March.
She is running for mayor.
He runs a small translation agency.
m.xz: 他經營一家小型翻譯社。

m.x: Several papers ran the story on the front page.
m.xz: 好幾家報紙把這則新聞登在頭版。

m.x: I'll run you to the station.

p.x: The batteries have run down.
p.xz: 電池沒電了。

p.x: We ran into problems with the visa.
p.xz: 我們在簽證上遇到問題。

p.zh: 逃走；私奔；捲款潛逃；印出

p.x: We're running out of time.
p.xz: 我們時間快不夠了。

p.zh: 溢出；超出（預算、時間）；複習；輾過

p.x: Let's run through the agenda before the guests arrive.
p.xz: 客人到之前，我們先把議程過一遍。

p.zh: 累積（債務）；升起（旗子）；趕製

i: don't run before you can walk
循序漸進・別好高騖遠
verbs.tip: 「經營公司」「主持專案」用 run 就夠：run a company、run a project，不一定要 manage 或 operate。「時間快不夠了」是 We're running out of time.，「會議超時」是 The meeting ran over.

verbs.core: 「看見」，再延伸為「看懂」「經歷」「會面」，以及「確保」事情辦好。

m.x: I see what you mean.
We saw a great play last weekend.
m.xz: 我們上週末看了一齣很棒的戲。

m.x: The region has seen rapid growth over the past decade.
m.xz: 這個地區過去十年快速成長。

m.x: You should see a doctor about that cough.
m.xz: 你咳成這樣，應該去看醫生。

m.x: I'll see that everyone gets a copy.
m.xz: 我會確保每個人都拿到一份。

p.x: Our hosts drove all the way to the station to see us off.
p.xz: 主人一路開車到車站為我們送行。

echo: see sb in a different light
see where the wind is blowing
see things from someone else's position
verbs.tip: 「我明白了」「原來如此」說 I see. 就好，比 I understand 輕鬆自然。中文的「見證」翻成 witness 很正式，描述趨勢時常說 The country has seen…（這個國家經歷了…）。

verbs.core: 「放定、定下」：把東西放好、把時間定下、把規則立好，也讓事情開始運作；太陽「落下」也是 set。

m.x: She set the tray on the table.
Let's set a date for the next meeting.
m.xz: 我們訂一下下次開會的日期。

m.x: The new rules set a high standard for safety.
m.xz: 新規定為安全訂下高標準。

m.x: Her remarks set everyone talking.
m.xz: 她的話引起大家議論紛紛。

m.x: I've set my alarm for six.

p.x: What sets this firm apart is its service.
p.xz: 這家公司與眾不同之處在於服務。

p.x: We've set aside a day for site visits.
p.xz: 我們撥出一天做實地參訪。

p.x: The announcement set off a wave of protests.
p.xz: 這項宣布引發一波抗議。

p.x: The two governments set up a joint task force.
p.xz: 兩國政府成立聯合工作小組。

verbs.tip: 「成立」「設立」機構、小組、基金，說 set up 最自然；更正式的書面才用 establish。「設定目標」是 set a goal、「訂定期限」是 set a deadline。

verbs.core: 「坐下、待著不動」：入座、擔任委員，延伸為（議會）開會、（建築）坐落。

m.x: Please sit wherever you like.
She sits on the ethics committee.
m.xz: 她是倫理委員會的委員。

m.x: The legislature sits until the end of May.
The temple sits on a hill above the town.
m.xz: 寺廟坐落在小鎮上方的山丘上。

p.x: Journalists may sit in on the first session.
p.xz: 記者可以旁聽第一場會議。

verbs.tip: 會議裡的「旁聽」是 sit in on；「擔任董事、委員」常說 sit on the board／committee。「不表態」可譯 sit on the fence，帶點批評意味。

verbs.core: 「試」：試試看、試吃試用，延伸為（法院）審理；考驗某人的耐性也是 try。

m.x: Have you tried the new noodle place downstairs?
m.xz: 你吃過樓下那家新開的麵店嗎？

m.x: The case will be tried in the High Court.
m.xz: 本案將由高等法院審理。

m.x: His constant questions were starting to try her patience.
m.xz: 他一直問個不停，讓她快沒耐性了。

m.x: I'll try to get there by seven.

p.x: Can I try this jacket on?
p.xz: 這件外套可以試穿嗎？

verbs.tip: 「我盡量」是 I'll try. 或 I'll do my best.；try to do 是「努力去做」，try doing 是「試試看做」：Try restarting the computer.（試試重開機。）

verbs.core: 「拿來用」：使用工具與方法、消耗資源，也指利用他人。

m.x: Can I use your charger?
m.xz: 可以借用你的充電器嗎？

m.x: The new system uses far less electricity.
I felt she was just using me.
m.xz: 我覺得她只是在利用我。

i: no use crying over spilt milk
use every trick in the book
不用就會生疏・不用就失效
echo: use public resources for private ends
verbs.tip: 「我很需要幫忙」口語可說 I could use some help.；「學以致用」可譯 put what you've learned to good use。utilize 多見於正式書面，口說用 use 即可。

verbs.core: 「贏得」：比賽勝出，也指爭取到獎項、支持與好感。

m.x: Who won the election?
The film won three awards at Golden Horse.
m.xz: 這部電影在金馬獎拿下三個獎項。

m.x: Our team won by two points.
m.xz: 我們隊以兩分之差獲勝。

p.x: We need to win over the undecided voters.
p.xz: 我們必須爭取中間選民的支持。

verbs.tip: 「爭取支持」「贏得信任」說 win support、win trust，比 obtain 有動感。「贏得掌聲」是 win applause，「拿下訂單」是 win the contract。

verbs.core: 「出聲叫」：叫喚、取名、打電話，延伸為召集（會議、選舉）、判定，以及順道拜訪。

m.x: Someone called my name from across the room.
m.xz: 有人在房間另一頭叫我的名字。

m.x: I wouldn't call it a failure.
They called their daughter Joy.
Could you call me a taxi?
m.xz: 可以幫我叫輛計程車嗎？

m.zh: 召集・宣布（會議、選舉、罷工）
m.x: The government called a snap election for March.
m.xz: 政府宣布三月提前大選。

m.x: I'll call again later.

p.x: Could you ask her to call me back?
p.xz: 可以請她回我電話嗎？

p.x: The situation calls for a quick response.
p.xz: 這種情況需要迅速回應。

p.x: The strike was called off at the last minute.
p.xz: 罷工在最後一刻取消。

p.zh: 喊出；調派（軍隊）；公開指責

i: 宣布開會・請大家肅靜
verbs.tip: 會議主席的「現在開會」是 I'd like to call the meeting to order.；「呼籲」可用 call on／call for，比 appeal 更常見。「這個決定很難下」可以說 That's a tough call.

verbs.core: 「朝說話者或目標靠近」：來、到達、達成，延伸為來自、結果是、變成、總計。

m.x: Come and sit with us.
The two sides finally came to an agreement.
Nothing good can come of rushing.
m.xz: 操之過急不會有好結果。

m.x: Where do you come from?
The knot has come undone.
The bill came to NT$3,400.
m.xz: 帳單總共新臺幣三千四百元。

p.x: How did the merger come about?
p.xz: 這次合併是怎麼促成的？

p.x: He comes across as a little arrogant.
p.xz: 他給人有點傲慢的感覺。

p.x: Good interpreters are hard to come by.
p.xz: 好的口譯員可遇不可求。

p.zh: 進來；（消息）傳來；派上用場

p.x: The issue didn't come up at the meeting.
p.xz: 會上沒有人提到這個問題。

echo: come away with a great deal
verbs.tip: 「我馬上來」說 I'm coming.，不是 I'm going.；英文以「對方的位置」為準。「達成共識」說 come to an agreement／come to a consensus，比 reach 更口語。

verbs.core: 「往下掉」：落下、跌倒，延伸為下跌、垮台、陣亡，以及「落在」某天或某人身上。

m.x: Snow fell all night.
She slipped and fell on the ice.
Exports fell by 5% last quarter.
m.xz: 上一季出口下滑百分之五。

m.zh: 陣亡；（政權）倒台；（城市）失守
m.x: The government fell after a vote of no confidence.
m.xz: 不信任案通過後，政府垮台。

p.x: The deal fell apart at the last minute.
p.xz: 這筆交易在最後一刻告吹。

p.x: We can fall back on the old system if needed.
p.xz: 必要時我們可以退回舊系統。

p.x: The project has fallen behind schedule.
p.xz: 專案進度落後了。

p.x: This year the festival falls on a Monday.
p.xz: 今年節日剛好在星期一。

p.x: Our travel plans fell through.
p.xz: 我們的旅行計畫泡湯了。

verbs.tip: 「下滑」「跌」用 fall 或 drop 即可：Sales fell sharply.；「餘波」「後續影響」可說 the fall-out from…，口譯財經與政治新聞時很常用。

verbs.core: 「用身體與心去感受」：觸摸、感覺到、覺得，延伸為「認為」。

m.x: Feel how soft this fabric is.
m.xz: 摸摸看這塊布料有多軟。

m.x: You could feel the tension in the room.
m.xz: 會場裡可以感受到緊張氣氛。

m.x: I feel we should wait for more data.
m.xz: 我覺得我們應該等更多數據出來。

m.x: The water feels warm.
I feel much better today.

p.x: I don't feel like cooking tonight.
p.xz: 我今晚不想煮飯。

p.zh: 覺得有能力・有體力做

verbs.tip: 「我認為」不必每次都說 I think，I feel… 語氣較柔和，適合表達看法而非下結論。「請隨意」說 Feel free.，口譯致詞時很常用：Please feel free to ask questions.

verbs.core: 「找到」：發現東西、找出辦法，延伸為「覺得」與（法院）判定。

m.x: I can't find my badge anywhere.
m.xz: 我到處都找不到我的識別證。

m.x: We need to find funding for the second phase.
m.xz: 我們得替第二期找到資金。

m.x: I find his argument convincing.
m.xz: 我覺得他的論點很有說服力。

m.x: She found herself alone in a foreign city.
m.xz: 她發覺自己孤身一人在異鄉。

m.x: This species is found only in Taiwan.
The jury found him not guilty.

p.x: Let me find out what time the session starts.
p.xz: 我去查一下場次幾點開始。

i: 適應新環境・站穩腳步
take me as you find me
難得的好東西・好人才
echo: find tranquility (in your inner-self) even you are in a metropolitan
verbs.tip: 「我覺得…很…」用 I find + 受詞 + 形容詞 很道地：I find it hard to believe.。「查清楚」「打聽」說 find out，比 ascertain 口語得多。

verbs.core: 「交出去」：給予、提供，延伸為做出某個動作（演講、建議、嘆氣），也指受壓而「讓步」「塌陷」。

m.x: Could you give this to the chair?
m.xz: 可以把這個交給主席嗎？

m.x: The pass gives delegates entry to every session.
m.xz: 這張通行證讓代表可以進入每一場會議。

m.zh: 做出（演講、證詞、聲音、信號）
m.x: She gave an excellent speech.
m.xz: 她發表了一場精彩的演講。

m.x: The news gave us a lot of hope.
m.xz: 這個消息帶給我們很大希望。

m.x: Each side will need to give a little to reach a deal.
m.xz: 雙方都得各退一步才能達成協議。

p.x: Please don't give away the plot twist.
p.xz: 拜託別透露劇情轉折。

p.x: Don't give up now — you're almost there.
p.xz: 別現在放棄，你快成功了。

i: give sb a piece of one's mind
verbs.tip: 很多中文的動作名詞都能接 give：「發表演講」give a speech、「提出建議」give advice、「做簡報」give a presentation、「嘆一口氣」give a sigh，比找特定動詞省力。

verbs.core: 「握住不放」：拿著、抓住、扣留，延伸為維持、容納、持有、舉行，以及（說法）站得住腳。

m.x: Hold the rail as you go down the stairs.
Two suspects are being held for questioning.
m.xz: 兩名嫌犯遭到拘留偵訊。

m.x: Hold that position for ten seconds.
The hall holds about 800 people.
m.xz: 這個大廳可容納約八百人。

m.x: She holds a doctorate in law.
The court held that the contract was invalid.
The summit will be held in Taipei.
Let's hope the good weather holds.
Could you hold, please?
The same rule holds for online sales.
m.xz: 同樣的規則也適用於網路銷售。

p.x: She held back her tears.
p.xz: 她強忍住淚水。

p.x: Hold on, let me check.
p.xz: 等一下，我查查看。

p.zh: 撐住；伸出；抱持（希望）；堅持要求

p.x: We were held up by heavy traffic.
p.xz: 我們遇到大塞車，耽擱了。

echo: holding a wolf by the ears
hold on to a rare commodity
verbs.tip: 「舉辦會議」說 hold a meeting、hold talks、hold elections，比 conduct 或 organise 常用。「這個說法站得住腳」是 The argument holds.。電話中的「請稍候」是 Please hold.

verbs.core: 讓東西「留在原處、維持原狀」：保留、保持、遵守；連「一直做」也是讓動作持續下去。

m.x: You can keep this copy; I have another one.
m.xz: 這份你留著，我還有一份。

m.x: Please keep your answers brief.
They keep chickens in the backyard.
Sorry to keep you waiting.
He always keeps his promises.
We keep a record of every request.
m.xz: 每一筆申請我們都有記錄。

m.x: The phone kept ringing throughout the meeting.
m.xz: 開會時電話一直響個不停。

m.x: Cooked rice won't keep for long.

p.x: Fluency comes slowly, so keep at it.
p.xz: 流利需要時間，堅持下去就對了。

p.x: I'm trying to keep off sugar this month.
p.xz: 這個月我在戒糖。

p.x: Please keep to the five-minute time limit.
p.xz: 請遵守五分鐘的時間限制。

p.x: It's hard to keep up with a fast speaker.
p.xz: 講者語速快的時候，很難跟上。

i: 賺取生活費・對得起薪水
verbs.tip: 「一直、不斷」不必用 continuously：He kept interrupting.（他一直插話。）就很道地。keep + V-ing 有時帶點抱怨語氣，譯成中文時可以保留。

verbs.core: 「使停止存在」：殺死、致命，延伸為扼殺計畫、消磨時間，以及誇張的「痛死了」「笑死了」「想得要命」。

m.x: Two workers were killed in the explosion.
m.xz: 爆炸造成兩名工人死亡。

m.x: The budget cuts killed the project.
m.xz: 預算刪減讓這項計畫胎死腹中。

m.x: My back is killing me.
Your stories kill me.
I'd kill for a cold drink right now.
Speed kills.

i: kill the goose that lays the golden egg
kill two birds with one stone
echo: kill the goose that lays the golden eggs
verbs.tip: 「消磨時間」是 kill time；「一舉兩得」是 kill two birds with one stone。kill 的誇張用法在口語很常見，正式口譯時要依場合斟酌，別把 My feet are killing me 譯成字面意思。

verbs.core: 「走在前面帶路」：引導、領導、領先，延伸為導致某種結果，以及過某種生活。

m.x: The host led us to the conference room.
She led the delegation to Brussels.
The data led us to rethink our approach.
m.xz: 這些數據讓我們重新思考做法。

m.x: They lead a simple life in the mountains.
m.xz: 他們在山上過著簡樸的生活。

m.x: This corridor leads to the main hall.
Poor planning can lead to delays.
m.xz: 規劃不周可能導致延誤。

p.x: In the days leading up to the summit, security was tightened.
p.xz: 峰會前幾天，維安層級提高。

i: lead sb up the garden path
verbs.tip: 「導致」用 lead to 最自然，比 result in、give rise to 口語；「率團」是 lead a delegation。新聞裡「頭條報導」常說 lead with…：The evening news led with the earthquake.

verbs.core: 「活著、過日子」：生存、居住、過某種生活，延伸為靠…維生、盡情享受人生。

m.x: She lived to 102.
Where do you live?
They live quite simply.
It's hard to live on a part-time salary.
He lived a long and happy life.
m.xz: 他度過了長壽而快樂的一生。

p.x: Many retirees live on their pensions.
p.xz: 許多退休人士靠退休金過活。

s: spend the rest of one's life

p.x: My grandparents lived through the war.
p.xz: 我祖父母經歷過戰爭。

p.x: The sequel didn't live up to expectations.
p.xz: 續集沒有達到大家的期待。

i: man cannot live by bread alone
自己活也讓別人活・互相包容
echo: live with it, die with it
verbs.tip: 「這個條件我可以接受」可以說 I can live with that.，語氣輕鬆，比 accept 有彈性。「不負眾望」是 live up to expectations。

verbs.core: 「把目光投向」：看、找，延伸為「看起來」；搭配介副詞後衍生出照顧、調查、尊敬等大量用法。

m.x: Look at this chart for a moment.
We looked everywhere for the keys.
You look tired — are you OK?

p.x: Who's looking after the children today?
p.xz: 今天誰照顧孩子？

p.x: The ministry has promised to look into the complaint.
p.xz: 部會承諾會調查這起申訴。

p.x: Could you look over my draft?
p.xz: 可以幫我看一下草稿嗎？

p.x: Things are finally looking up.
p.xz: 情況終於好轉了。

i: 小錢顧好，大錢自然存得住
look a gift horse in the mouth
對別人送的東西挑三揀四
echo: look at each other in dismay
verbs.tip: 「看起來」用 look + 形容詞（look tired）或 look like + 名詞（look like rain）。「我們會研究一下」說 We'll look into it.，比 investigate 婉轉，是官方回應的常用語。

verbs.core: 「失去」：弄丟東西、輸掉比賽、喪失權利，延伸為浪費時間，以及讓人聽得一頭霧水。

m.x: I've lost my boarding pass.
They lost the final on penalties.
m.xz: 他們在決賽踢點球輸了。

m.x: Thousands of workers lost their jobs.
Sorry, you've lost me.
There's no time to lose.

p.x: Small farmers will lose out under the new rules.
p.xz: 新制度下小農會吃虧。

i: you win some, you lose some
verbs.tip: 口譯時聽不懂對方的意思，可以禮貌地說 I'm afraid you've lost me.；「錯失機會」用 miss，「失去優勢」用 lose ground，兩者不要混用。

verbs.core: 讓事情「成形」：做出東西、造成結果、促使別人行動；連「趕上」「賺到」也是把結果做出來。

m.x: The delay made everyone nervous.
m.xz: 延誤讓大家都緊張起來。

m.zh: 做出・製造・制定・構成
m.x: We've made a shortlist of three candidates.
m.xz: 我們擬出三人的候選名單。

m.x: You'd make an excellent moderator.
m.xz: 你會是很出色的主持人。

m.x: If we leave now, we can still make the last train.
m.xz: 現在出發還趕得上末班車。

m.x: The startup hasn't made a profit yet.
m.xz: 這家新創公司還沒獲利。

m.x: Nobody can make you sign it.

p.x: A clear agenda makes for a shorter meeting.
p.xz: 議程清楚，會議就開得短。

p.zh: 看清・聽清；理解；把…說成
p.x: The audio was so poor that we couldn't make out the speaker's words.
p.xz: 音質太差，我們聽不清楚講者在說什麼。

p.zh: 編造；整理（房間）；和好；構成
p.x: Women make up 40 percent of the workforce.
p.xz: 女性占勞動力的四成。

p.x: We added an extra session to make up for the cancelled class.
p.xz: 我們加開一堂課，補回停掉的那堂。

i: make hay while the sun shines
verbs.tip: make it 一個說法就能涵蓋「趕上、出席、成功」：Can you make it on Friday?（週五能來嗎？）、She made it to the finals.（她打進決賽。）中譯英遇到「來得及、到得了、成功了」，先想到 make it。

verbs.core: 「相遇、碰在一起」：見面、開會，延伸為滿足（需求）、達到（期限）、支付（費用）、迎接（挑戰）。

m.x: Nice to meet you.
The design must meet safety standards.
m.xz: 設計必須符合安全標準。

m.x: Can we still meet the deadline?
m.xz: 我們還趕得上截止日嗎？

m.x: The proposal was met with strong opposition.
m.xz: 這項提案遭到強烈反對。

m.x: The committee meets once a month.
Have you two met?

p.x: The minister met with business leaders this morning.
p.xz: 部長今早與企業領袖會談。

verbs.tip: 「符合標準」「滿足需求」「達成目標」都能用 meet：meet standards、meet needs、meet targets，比 satisfy 簡潔。「各退一步」是 meet halfway。

verbs.core: 「改變位置」：移動、搬家，延伸為改期、推進、促使、打動人心，以及在會議上提出動議。

m.x: Don't move — there's a bee on your arm.
m.xz: 別動，你手臂上有隻蜜蜂。

m.x: The meeting has moved to Thursday.
Negotiations are moving quickly.
We're moving to Taichung next month.
Could you move your car, please?
We were all deeply moved by her speech.
m.xz: 她的演講讓我們都深受感動。

m.x: I move that the meeting be adjourned.

p.x: Shall we move on to item three?
p.xz: 我們進入第三項議程好嗎？

verbs.tip: 會議主席說「進入下一個議題」是 Let's move on to…；議事規則裡「我提案」是 I move that…。「感動」除了 touch，也常說 be moved。

verbs.core: 「打開」：開門、拆封、展開，延伸為開始（調查、對話）、開業、上映。

m.x: Please open the attachment.
The police have opened an investigation.
The museum opens at nine.
The film opens in Taipei on Friday.

p.x: The country is opening up its market to foreign investors.
p.xz: 這個國家正向外資開放市場。

i: 自找麻煩・惹出一堆問題
verbs.tip: 「宣布開幕」「開幕致詞」可以說 open the conference、opening remarks；「保留彈性」說 keep our options open，談判口譯很常聽到。

verbs.core: 「經過、通過」：越過某處、傳遞東西、通過考試或法案，延伸為時間流逝、事情過去，以及「跳過」。

m.x: We passed the station on the way.
Could you pass me the agenda?
Visitor numbers passed one million this year.
m.xz: 今年遊客人數突破一百萬。

m.x: Did you pass the interpreting exam?
Parliament passed the bill by a narrow margin.
m.xz: 國會以些微差距通過法案。

m.x: Two years passed before we heard from him.
m.xz: 兩年後我們才有他的消息。

m.x: The storm will pass by morning.
m.xz: 暴風雨到早上就會過去。

m.zh: 不回答・放棄作答（pass on）

m.x: I'll pass on dessert, thanks.

p.x: She was passed over for promotion again.
p.xz: 她又沒獲得升遷。

p.x: It's too good an opportunity to pass up.
p.xz: 這個機會好得不能錯過。

verbs.tip: 立法院「三讀通過」可說 The bill passed its third reading.；「我跳過」「我不回答這題」是 I'll pass.。「推卸責任」說 pass the buck，比 shirk responsibility 口語。

verbs.core: 「玩、演、奏」：從事運動與遊戲、扮演角色、演奏或播放音樂，延伸為發揮作用、給人某種觀感。

m.x: Taiwan plays Japan in the semi-final.
m.xz: 臺灣在準決賽對上日本。

m.x: Taiwan plays a key role in the chip supply chain.
m.xz: 臺灣在晶片供應鏈中扮演關鍵角色。

m.x: She plays the cello in a local orchestra.
m.xz: 她在地方樂團拉大提琴。

m.x: The speech played well with young voters.
m.xz: 這場演說在年輕選民間反應不錯。

p.x: Officials played down the risks.
p.xz: 官員淡化了風險。

p.x: It's too early to say how this will play out.
p.xz: 現在還很難說會怎麼發展。

i: two can play at that game
唱反調（故意提出反面意見）
verbs.tip: 「扮演…角色」說 play a role／play a part，正式場合最常見。「見機行事」是 play it by ear，「唱反調以檢驗論點」是 play devil's advocate，討論會口譯很常聽到。

verbs.core: 「往自己這邊拉」：拖、拔，延伸為吸引人潮、拉傷肌肉，以及開車靠邊、撤出、撐過難關。

m.x: Pull the door, don't push it.
The festival pulls huge crowds every year.
m.xz: 這個節慶每年都吸引大批人潮。

m.x: He pulled a muscle during the warm-up.

p.x: Nobody thought they could pull it off.
p.xz: 沒人想到他們真能辦成。

p.x: Two sponsors have pulled out of the event.
p.xz: 兩家贊助商退出了這項活動。

i: pull the rug from under sb
釜底抽薪・突然撤回支持
verbs.tip: 「退出協定」「撤資」說 pull out of…，新聞口譯很常用；「動用關係」是 pull strings；「同心協力」是 pull together。

verbs.core: 「讀」：閱讀文字，延伸為解讀（心思、局勢）、唸出來、（儀器）顯示，英式說法也指在大學主修。

m.x: Have you read the briefing notes?
It's hard to read his mood.
She read the statement aloud.
The thermometer read 38 degrees.
He read law at Oxford.
I read about it in the news.
m.xz: 我在新聞上看到這件事。

p.x: I need to read up on the semiconductor industry before the job.
p.xz: 接案前我得先惡補半導體產業。

p.x: Don't read too much into it.
p.xz: 別想太多。

verbs.tip: 口譯員接案前的「做功課」可以說 read up on the topic。「解讀」政策訊號、市場情緒也能用 read：How do you read the market?（你怎麼解讀市場？）

verbs.core: 「賣出去」：把貨品換成錢，延伸為推銷想法、讓人接受；東西「賣得動」也是 sell。

m.x: We'll have to sell the plan to the board first.
m.xz: 我們得先說服董事會接受這個計畫。

m.x: The new model is selling well in Asia.
m.xz: 新機型在亞洲賣得很好。

p.x: The group is selling off its overseas assets.
p.xz: 集團正在出售海外資產。

p.x: Tickets sold out within an hour.
p.xz: 票一小時內就賣光了。

verbs.tip: 簡報或談判裡的「說服對方接受」常用 sell：sell the idea、sell the plan。「搶手」是 sell like hot cakes；市場的「拋售」是 sell-off。

verbs.core: 「送出去」：寄、派遣，延伸為讓人陷入某種狀態、讓東西飛出去或數字急升急降。

m.x: I'll send you the slides after the meeting.
m.xz: 會後我把投影片寄給你。

m.x: The noise is sending me crazy.
The news sent oil prices soaring.

p.x: Should we send for a doctor?
p.xz: 要不要請醫生來？

p.x: Please send in your application by Friday.
p.xz: 請在週五前提交申請。

i: send sb off with a flea in their ear
verbs.tip: 「發出訊號」可以說 send a signal／send a message：The decision sends a clear message to investors.（這項決定向投資人釋出明確訊號。）比 convey 自然。

verbs.core: 「讓人看見」：出示、展示、指給人看，延伸為顯示、證明、帶路，以及「看得出來」「露面」。

m.x: Please show your passport at the gate.
The map shows where the exits are.
m.xz: 地圖上標示出口的位置。

m.x: Let me show you to your seat.
The documentary shows life in a fishing village.
m.xz: 這部紀錄片呈現漁村生活。

m.x: The figures show that demand is recovering.
m.xz: 數字顯示需求正在回升。

m.x: Try not to let your nerves show.
m.xz: 盡量別讓人看出你很緊張。

p.zh: 出現；顯現；讓人難堪；揭露
p.x: Only half the speakers showed up.
p.xz: 只有一半的講者到場。

i: have nothing to show for it
let's get this show on the road
verbs.tip: 「數據顯示」說 The data show…，比 indicate 口語；「露臉」「到場」是 show up。帶貴賓入座的「這邊請」可說 Let me show you the way.

verbs.core: 「留在原地、維持不變」：停留、住宿，也指保持某種狀態；法律上則是「暫緩」。

m.x: Please stay seated until the plane stops.
m.xz: 飛機停妥前請留在座位上。

m.x: Where are you staying in Taipei?

p.x: The court decided to stay out of the dispute.
p.xz: 法院決定不介入這場爭議。

verbs.tip: 「保持聯絡」是 stay in touch；「維持穩定」可以說 stay stable 或 remain stable。stay 偏口語，remain 偏書面，口譯時依場合挑選。

verbs.core: 把東西「拿過來、帶著走」：拿取、帶去、搭乘，再延伸到「花費（時間）」「承受」與「接受」。

m.x: Feel free to take a brochure on your way out.
If you take 5 from 12, you get 7.
I'll take you back to the hotel after the reception.
m.xz: 酒會結束後我送你回飯店。

m.x: The approval process usually takes about six weeks.
m.xz: 審核流程通常要六週左右。

m.x: We took the high-speed rail down to Tainan.
Let's take a short break before the Q&A.
m.xz: 問答之前我們先休息一下。

m.xz: 這種壓力我再也受不了了。

p.x: She takes after her father in temperament.
p.xz: 她的個性像爸爸。

p.x: I take that back — it was unfair of me.
p.xz: 那句話我收回，是我說得不公道。

p.zh: 消化理解；收留；上當；參觀
p.x: It was a lot of information to take in at once.
p.xz: 一下子資訊太多，很難消化。

p.zh: 脫下；扣除；休假；起飛；走紅
p.x: Online sales really took off during the pandemic.
p.xz: 疫情期間網購迅速起飛。

p.x: She has taken on too many projects this year.
p.xz: 她今年接了太多案子。

p.zh: 取出；申辦（貸款）；拿人出氣
p.x: Don't take your frustration out on the staff.
p.xz: 別把怒氣發洩在員工身上。

p.x: Who will take over when the chair steps down?
p.xz: 主席卸任後由誰接手？

p.x: She took up running after she retired.
p.xz: 她退休後開始跑步。

i: won't take no for an answer
verbs.tip: 「做決定」英式常說 take a decision，美式多說 make a decision，國際會議兩種都聽得到。「花了多久」用 It takes + 時間 最自然，主詞是事情本身：It took three rounds of talks to reach a deal.（談了三輪才達成協議。）

verbs.core: 「交談」：說話、聊天、談判，也指說閒話與招供；口語中還能強調「我們說的可是…」。

m.x: Can we talk about this later?
m.xz: 這件事我們晚點再談好嗎？

m.x: The two sides are still talking.
We're talking millions of dollars here.
m.xz: 這可是好幾百萬美元的事。

p.x: She talked me into giving the keynote.
p.xz: 她說服我擔任主講。

p.x: Let's talk it over with the team.
p.xz: 我們跟團隊商量一下。

i: like talking to a brick wall
talk the hind leg off a donkey
verbs.tip: 外交場合的「會談」可以說 hold talks，「雙方持續溝通」是 The two sides are still talking.。「說服」不一定要 persuade，talk sb into sth 更口語。

verbs.core: 「告訴」：通知、講述、吩咐，延伸為「分辨、看得出」，以及（壓力）開始顯現。

m.x: Could you tell me where the press room is?
Tell us a bit about your background.
The guard told us to wait outside.
I could tell she was nervous.
I told you it wouldn't work.
The long hours are starting to tell.
m.xz: 長時間工作開始讓人吃不消。

p.x: The coach told the players off for being late.
p.xz: 教練罵了遲到的球員。

verbs.tip: 「我看得出來」「分不出來」都用 tell：I can tell.／I can't tell the difference.，比 distinguish 自然。「告訴」接人當受詞（tell me），「說」接內容（say that…），別混用。

verbs.core: 「轉」：旋轉、轉向、翻面，延伸為轉變、變成（某種狀態），以及（年紀）滿幾歲。

m.x: The wheels began to turn.
She turns forty next month.
Turn left at the second light.
Please turn to page twelve.

p.x: They turned down our offer.
p.xz: 他們拒絕了我們的提議。

p.x: The protest turned into a riot.
p.xz: 抗議演變成暴動。

p.zh: 關掉；轉離（主路）；讓人失去興趣

p.x: It turned out to be a misunderstanding.
p.xz: 結果原來是一場誤會。

p.x: He turned up an hour late.
p.xz: 他晚了一小時才出現。

i: 忍耐也有限度・兔子急了也咬人
a bad penny always turns up
take a turn for the worse
verbs.tip: 「結果發現」說 It turned out (that)…，口譯時非常好用；「投票率」是 turnout、「營業額」英式說 turnover。「轉捩點」是 turning point。

verbs.core: 「等」：停下來等候、期待，延伸為「已經準備好等著」與「可以晚點再說」。

m.x: Please wait here until your name is called.
We've waited years for this decision.
m.xz: 這個決定我們等了好幾年。

m.x: A car will be waiting for you at the airport.
The rest can wait until tomorrow.

i: wait on sb hand and foot
echo: waiting for the dust to settle
wait for the other shoe to drop
verbs.tip: 「靜觀其變」是 wait and see，常用來形容政府或市場觀望：a wait-and-see attitude（觀望態度）。「迫不及待」是 can't wait to…。

verbs.core: 「走路」：步行、陪人走，延伸為（嫌犯）無罪獲釋，以及帶人一步步走過流程。

m.x: It's only a ten-minute walk; let's walk.
m.xz: 走路只要十分鐘，我們用走的吧。

m.x: I'll walk you to the station.

p.xz: 買方退出談判。

p.xz: 幾位代表憤而離席抗議。

p.x: Let me walk you through the process.
p.xz: 我一步一步帶你了解流程。

verbs.tip: 「離席抗議」是 walk out；「詳細說明流程」可以說 walk sb through…，比 explain in detail 生動。談判的「退場點」就是 walk-away point。

verbs.core: 「想要」：渴望、希望某人做某事；古義是「缺少」，所以通緝犯是 wanted，也有「欠缺、不足」之意。

m.x: I want everyone to read this before Friday.
m.xz: 我要大家在週五前讀完這份資料。

m.x: You're wanted on the phone.
The plan was found wanting in several areas.
m.xz: 這項計畫在好幾方面都有不足。

i: for want of a better word
verbs.tip: 「我想要…」在正式場合改說 I'd like… 較禮貌；I want 語氣直接，口譯時要依講者身分斟酌。be found wanting 是「評為不足」的正式說法，常見於評鑑報告。

verbs.core: 「出力運作」：工作、操作，也指（機器）運轉、（方法）奏效，以及慢慢把東西加工成形。

She worked her way up from receptionist to CEO.
m.xz: 她從櫃檯人員一路做到執行長。

m.x: Where do you work?
The new system works well.

p.x: I'll try to work you into my schedule.
p.xz: 我會設法把你排進我的行程。

p.zh: 結果；解決；理解；運動；算出
p.x: Let's sit down and work something out.
p.xz: 我們坐下來想個辦法吧。

i: work one's fingers to the bone
throw a spanner in the works

verbs.core: 「打斷、打破」：弄斷、弄壞、違反，延伸為打破僵局、休息片刻，以及消息「傳開」、天氣「轉變」。

She broke her wrist skiing.
Who broke the printer?
They broke the terms of the contract.

The story broke late last night.
m.xz: 這則新聞昨晚深夜爆出。

p.xz: 談判在週末破裂。

p.zh: 闖入；突然開始；打入（市場）
p.x: The company is trying to break into the Japanese market.
p.xz: 這家公司正設法打入日本市場。

p.xz: 邊境附近爆發戰鬥。

m.xz: 報到時請攜帶身分證件。

p.xz: 會議提前到星期一。

p.xz: 我想再提一點。

verbs.core: 「一層層蓋起來」：建造房屋，延伸為建立（關係、事業）、累積，以及（緊張）逐漸升高。

verbs.core: 「離開、留下」：出發、離去，延伸為把東西留在原處、留給別人決定，以及遺留、遺贈。

m.x: The flight leaves Taoyuan at 8:40.
m.xz: 班機八點四十分從桃園起飛。

m.xz: 她會議還沒結束就走了。

i: leave a lot to be desired
echo: leave no stone unturned in N
leave a legacy that lives on

verbs.core: 「伸手搆到」：抵達、達到（數字、協議），也指伸手拿、聯絡上某人。

m.x: We should reach the hotel by noon.
m.xz: 我們中午前應該會到飯店。

m.x: The two sides reached an agreement after midnight.
m.xz: 雙方午夜過後達成協議。

echo: reaching a point of no return; to stake everything on success

verbs.core: 「開口說」：說話、講某種語言、發言演講，比 talk 正式，也較著重單方面發言。

m.x: How many languages do you speak?

m.xz: 部長將在開幕典禮上致詞。

p.xz: 我相信大家的心聲都一樣：謝謝你。

p.xz: 越來越多科學家公開談論氣候風險。

p.xz: 可以說大聲一點嗎？

verbs.tip: 「致詞」「發言」用 speak；「發言人」是 spokesperson。口譯開場常說 I'll be speaking in the first person on behalf of the speaker.（我將以講者的第一人稱口譯。）

verbs.core: 「站著、立著」：站立、矗立，延伸為立場、處境、數字「為」，以及「受得了」。

m.xz: 失業率為百分之三點四。

Small exporters stand to lose the most.

p.xz: 我們堅持這個決定。

p.xz: WTO 代表什麼？

p.x: Her proposal stood out from the rest.
p.xz: 她的提案在眾多提案中脫穎而出。

i: not have a leg to stand on
stand on one's own two feet
verbs.tip: 數據口譯的「為」「達」常用 stand at：GDP growth stands at 2.1%.；表態的「立場」用 Where do you stand on…?，比 What is your position on…? 口語。

verbs.core: 「開始」：開始做某事、發動（機器）、創辦（事業），也有「嚇一跳」的意思。

echo: start with a bang and end with a whimper

i: 不當一回事・視為平常

verbs.core: 「丟出去」：投擲、拋，延伸為投射（目光、光線）、使人困惑，以及辦派對、發脾氣。

m.xz: 這個問題讓我一時愣住。

verbs.core: 「持續地看著」：觀看、盯著，延伸為監視、照看，以及「留意、注意」。

m.xz: 我們看了辯論的現場直播。

verbs.core: 「跟在後面」：跟隨、接著發生，延伸為沿著走、遵照、聽懂，以及持續關注。

m.x: A reception will follow the ceremony.
Follow the signs to the main hall.
Please follow the instructions carefully.
Sorry, I don't quite follow.
Are you following the trade talks?
m.xz: 你有在關注貿易談判嗎？

m.x: Details will follow.

p.x: It's not enough to promise; we need to follow through.
p.xz: 光承諾不夠，還必須落實。

p.x: I'll follow up with an email.
p.xz: 我會再寄電子郵件跟進。

i: 步某人後塵・子承父業
verbs.tip: 會議口譯常聽到 follow-up question（追問）和 follow up on…（追蹤處理）。「我沒聽懂」可以禮貌地說 I'm not sure I follow.，語氣比 I don't understand 委婉。

verbs.core: 「說出內容」：說話、表達、回答、聲稱，也用來估計（I'd say）與假設（say…）。

m.x: What did she say about the budget?
I didn't know what to say.
The company says it was not informed.
I'd say about two hundred people came.
m.xz: 我估計大約來了兩百人。

m.x: Let's say the deal falls through — what then?
m.xz: 假設交易告吹，那怎麼辦？

verbs.tip: 「據說」是 It is said that… 或 They say…；「也就是說」是 that is to say。估算時說 I'd say…，比 I estimate 自然得多。

verbs.core: 「長大、增加」：生長、成長，延伸為逐漸變得、種植，以及培養、發展（經濟）。

m.x: Demand for interpreters continues to grow.
The children have grown so much!
It's growing dark.
The government wants to grow the digital economy.
m.xz: 政府希望發展數位經濟。

i: mighty oaks from little acorns grow
not let the grass grow under one's feet
劍及履及・不浪費時間
verbs.tip: 「經濟成長」說 the economy grew by 3%；動詞 grow 也能當及物：grow the business（擴大業務）。「漸漸喜歡上」是 It grows on you.

verbs.core: 「出手幫忙」：協助、有助於，延伸為「忍不住」與「請自便」。

m.x: Volunteers helped with registration.
Talking about it might help.
I couldn't help laughing.
Could you help me with these boxes?
m.xz: 可以幫我搬這些箱子嗎？

i: God helps those who help themselves
echo: help when it is needed most
verbs.tip: 「我不禁想…」是 I can't help thinking…；請客人自己取用說 Please help yourself.。help 後面可直接接原形動詞：help reduce costs。

verbs.core: 「知道、認識」：一個 know 同時涵蓋「知道」（savoir）與「認識」（connaître），中文要依語境分開譯。

m.x: I know what you mean.
Do you know anyone at the embassy?
m.xz: 你在大使館有認識的人嗎？

echo: know how to play the game
Know when to make a move and when to stay put
verbs.tip: know 的中文要看受詞：know a fact 是「知道」，know a person 是「認識」，know a language 是「會」。「據我所知」是 as far as I know。

verbs.core: 「喜歡」：欣賞、愛好；would like 則是禮貌地表示「想要」。

m.x: I really like the new layout.
I'd like to make a short statement.
m.xz: 我想發表一段簡短的聲明。

i: 你覺得…怎麼樣；你喜歡…怎麼做
不管喜不喜歡都得接受
echo: like a fish out of water
verbs.tip: 正式場合說「我想…」用 I'd like to…，例如 I'd like to thank…，是致詞口譯的基本句型。

verbs.core: 「深愛」：愛人，也廣泛用來表示非常喜歡某件事物；I'd love to 是熱情答應的說法。

m.x: She loves her job.
I'd love to come, thanks.

i: all is fair in love and war
verbs.tip: 受邀時回答 I'd love to. 比 Yes, I will. 熱情得多。「市場不再青睞科技股」可以說 The market has fallen out of love with tech stocks.

verbs.core: 「意思是」：表示某種意義，延伸為「本意是」「意味著（某種結果）」，也表示「注定」。

m.x: What does this abbreviation mean?
I didn't mean to interrupt.
The merger will mean job losses.
It was meant to be.

verbs.tip: 口譯時講者說 What I mean is… 是在重述，可以譯成「我的意思是」；「你懂我意思嗎？」是 You know what I mean?。「這意味著…」用 This means…，比 imply 直接。

verbs.core: 「需要」：缺了就不行；延伸為必須、有必要。

m.x: We need more time.
The building needs some repairs.
You don't need to bring anything.

verbs.tip: 「你不必…」用 You don't need to／There's no need to…，比 You don't have to 委婉。「有需要的人」是 people in need。

verbs.core: 「看來、似乎」：表達印象，也用來把話說得委婉，避免太直接。

m.x: She seems very capable.
I can't seem to find the file.
m.xz: 我好像找不到那個檔案。

verbs.tip: It seems that… 和 I seem to… 是把話說軟的好工具：「看來有誤會」可以說 There seems to be a misunderstanding.，比 There is a misunderstanding 客氣。

verbs.core: 「停下」：停止動作、阻止別人，延伸為堵住，以及中途停留。

m.x: Please stop me if I'm going too fast.
m.xz: 如果我講太快，請打斷我。

m.x: Nothing can stop us now.
m.xz: 現在沒有什麼能阻止我們。

m.x: The rain has finally stopped.
We stopped in Hong Kong for two days.

verbs.tip: 口譯員請講者暫停可以說 Could you stop there for a moment?；stop doing 是「不再做」，stop to do 是「停下來去做」，意思完全不同。

verbs.core: 「容許」：准許、讓某事成為可能，延伸為預留（時間、預算）。

m.x: Photography is not allowed in the gallery.
Allow an extra 30 minutes for security checks.
m.xz: 安檢請多預留三十分鐘。

verbs.tip: 「考慮到通膨」是 allowing for inflation；「讓…得以」用 allow sb to do 或 enable，比 make it possible for 精簡。

verbs.core: 「開始」：與 start 相近，語氣略正式，常見於書面與典禮場合。

m.x: The ceremony will begin at ten.
The two sides will begin talks next week.

verbs.tip: begin 與 start 大多可互換，但機器發動只用 start（start the engine）。「首先」可說 To begin with…，比 First of all 正式一些。

verbs.core: 「學會、得知」：學習技能、背誦，也指聽說、獲悉某件事。

m.x: It takes years to learn simultaneous interpreting.
m.xz: 學會同步口譯要好幾年。

m.x: I learned the speech by heart.
We learned that the flight had been cancelled.

echo: learn one thing and apply it to others
verbs.tip: 「據悉」「獲悉」在新聞裡常說 It has been learned that… 或 We have learned that…；「從錯誤中學習」是 learn from mistakes。

verbs.core: 「主動提供」：把東西或機會遞到對方面前，等對方接受。

m.x: They offered me a job in Tokyo.
m.xz: 他們提供我一份東京的工作。

m.x: The hotel offers free shuttle buses.

verbs.tip: 「主動表示願意幫忙」說 offer to help；「致哀」是 offer condolences；「遞出橄欖枝」是 offer an olive branch，外交口譯常用。

verbs.core: 「往上提」：舉起、提高，延伸為養育、募集、提出（問題），以及引起（疑慮）。

m.x: Please raise your hand if you have a question.
The central bank raised interest rates.
She was born and raised in Kaohsiung.
The startup raised NT$100 million.
m.xz: 這家新創募得一億元新臺幣。

m.x: The report raises serious concerns.
m.xz: 這份報告引起嚴重疑慮。

m.x: I'd like to raise a point of order.

i: 揚眉（表示驚訝或不以為然）
verbs.tip: 「募資」說 raise funds／raise capital；「升息」是 raise rates；「提出問題」是 raise a question／raise an issue。raise 在財經與會議口譯裡出現頻率極高。

verbs.core: 「為人效勞」：服務、任職、上菜招待，延伸為服刑，以及「足以充當、發揮作用」。

m.x: She served two terms as mayor.
He is serving a five-year sentence.
Lunch will be served in the foyer.
Are you being served?

i: 腳踏兩條船・兩面討好
revenge is a dish best served cold
verbs.tip: 「擔任」職務說 serve as：She served as chair of the committee.；「以此為鑑」是 Let this serve as a lesson.。餐會口譯的「開始上菜」是 Dinner is served.

verbs.core: 「用掉」：花錢、度過時間，延伸為耗盡（體力、怒氣）。

m.x: We spent too much on the venue.
m.xz: 我們在場地上花太多錢了。

m.x: I spent the weekend preparing the glossary.
m.xz: 我花了整個週末準備詞彙表。

i: don't spend it all in one place
verbs.tip: 「花時間做某事」是 spend time doing，不是 spend time to do。財經新聞的「支出」也可直接用名詞 spend：marketing spend（行銷支出）。

verbs.core: 「出現在眼前」：露面、出現，延伸為「看起來」、登上媒體、出版，以及出庭。

m.x: The minister appeared relaxed.
A message appeared on the screen.
She often appears on TV talk shows.
The article will appear in next month's issue.
m.xz: 這篇文章將刊在下個月號。

m.x: The suspect will appear in court tomorrow.

verbs.tip: It appears that… 比 It seems that… 正式，適合新聞與公文口譯；「出庭」是 appear in court，「露面」是 make an appearance。

verbs.core: 「成為、變得」：狀態或身分的轉變；也有「適合、得體」的古典用法。

m.x: It's becoming harder to find qualified staff.
m.xz: 找到合格人才越來越難。

m.x: Such remarks hardly become a diplomat.
m.xz: 這種言論實在不符外交官身分。

m.x: Whatever became of your old business partner?
m.xz: 你以前的生意夥伴後來怎麼樣了？

echo: become obsessed to the point of madness
verbs.tip: 口語常用 get 代替 become：It's getting harder.；正式書面才用 become。「…後來怎麼樣了」是 What became of…?

verbs.core: 「換、變」：改變、更換、交換，也指轉乘、換衣服與換錢。

m.x: It's time to change our approach.
Can I change seats with you?
We changed planes in Bangkok.
The city has changed a lot.
Change at Taipei Main Station for the airport line.
m.xz: 在臺北車站轉搭機場線。

m.x: I need ten minutes to change.

i: a leopard can't change its spots
verbs.tip: 「改變主意」是 change one's mind，「易主」是 change hands，「換個方式」是 change tack。另外 change 當名詞也是「零錢」：Keep the change.

verbs.core: 「無中生有」：創造、創作，延伸為造成（局面、情緒）與創造（就業機會）。

m.x: The policy has created a lot of uncertainty.
m.xz: 這項政策造成很大的不確定性。

m.x: The project will create 500 jobs.
m.xz: 這項計畫將創造五百個就業機會。

verbs.tip: 「創造就業」是 create jobs；「營造氛圍」可以說 create an atmosphere。中文的「造成困擾」也常譯成 create problems。

verbs.core: 「拍板」：做出選擇，延伸為左右結果、裁決爭議。

m.x: We decided to postpone the launch.
A single goal decided the match.
The court will decide the case next month.
m.xz: 法院將於下月裁決此案。

verbs.tip: 「決定」不一定要 make a decision，直接 decide to do 更簡潔；「關鍵因素」是 the deciding factor。

verbs.core: 「預期」：預料會發生、期待某人來，延伸為要求，以及「我猜」。

m.x: The talks are expected to last two days.
We expect all members to attend.
m.xz: 我們要求所有成員出席。

m.x: I expect you're tired after the flight.
m.xz: 搭了這麼久的飛機，我想你一定累了。

verbs.tip: 新聞的「預計」常用 be expected to：The bill is expected to pass.；「不出所料」是 as expected。對人說 I expect you to… 帶有要求的意味，口譯時要留意語氣。

verbs.core: 「發生」：事情出現或演變，延伸為「碰巧」。

m.x: What happened at the meeting?
I happened to see him at the airport.
That happens to be the policy you voted for.
m.xz: 那恰好是你當初投票支持的政策。

verbs.tip: 「碰巧」「剛好」用 happen to：Do you happen to know…?（你是否剛好知道…？）是很客氣的問法。「某人出了事」說 happen to sb，不能寫成 be happened。

verbs.core: 「留下、保持」：仍然是某種狀態、留在原地，也指剩下。

m.zh: 保持・仍然・留下・剩下
m.x: Please remain seated.

echo: 泰山崩於前而面不改色
remain unruffled even if the sky falls
verbs.tip: remain 比 stay 正式，公告與新聞最常見：Prices remain high.（價格居高不下。）「有待觀察」是 It remains to be seen whether…，口譯時事評論很好用。

verbs.core: 「回報」：報告、報導、通報，也指報到與（職務上）向某人負責。

m.x: Please report to the front desk on arrival.
The task force reports directly to the premier.
m.xz: 該工作小組直接向行政院長負責。

m.x: The incident was reported to the police.
m.xz: 這起事件已向警方報案。

verbs.tip: 新聞的「據報導」是 reportedly 或 It is reported that…；職場的「直屬上司」是 the person you report to。

verbs.core: 「相信」：信以為真、信任某人，也用來委婉地表達「我認為」。

m.x: I believe we've met before.
Don't believe everything you read online.
m.xz: 別相信網路上看到的一切。

i: 不敢相信自己的眼睛／耳朵
不敢相信自己運氣這麼好
verbs.tip: 正式發言常用 I believe… 表達立場，語氣比 I think 堅定；believe in 是「信奉」，例如 We believe in open markets.（我們信奉開放市場。）

verbs.core: 「包含在內」：把某部分算進整體，也指讓人參與。

m.x: The price includes breakfast.
Thanks for including me.

verbs.tip: 列舉時的「包括」用 including，「不包括」用 excluding；「是否含稅」是 Is tax included?。正式文件常見 include but not limited to（包括但不限於）。

verbs.core: 「提供、供給」，延伸為（法律）規定，以及為未來預作準備。

m.x: Interpreting equipment will be provided.
m.xz: 主辦方會提供口譯設備。

m.x: The contract provides that disputes go to arbitration.
m.xz: 合約規定爭議交付仲裁。

verbs.tip: 法律口譯的「本法規定」常譯成 The Act provides that…；「提供」口語可用 give，provide 偏正式。

verbs.core: 「需要、要求」：比 need 正式，常見於規定與條件。

m.x: The job requires good English.
m.xz: 這份工作需要良好的英文能力。

m.x: Simultaneous interpreting requires intense concentration.
m.xz: 同步口譯需要高度專注。

m.x: The new rules require companies to disclose emissions data.
m.xz: 新規定要求企業揭露排放數據。

m.x: Visitors are required to sign in.

verbs.tip: 公告的「須」「應」常用 be required to：All passengers are required to…。口說場合換成 need to 或 have to 就好。

verbs.core: 「提出想法」：建議，延伸為暗示，以及（證據）顯示。

m.x: I suggest we take a short break.
Are you suggesting I'm wrong?
The data suggest a slowdown in demand.

verbs.tip: suggest 後面接 that 子句或 V-ing：suggest that we leave／suggest leaving，不說 suggest sb to do。研究報告的「顯示」用 suggest，語氣比 prove 保留。

verbs.core: 「仔細想」：考慮、斟酌，延伸為認為、把…列入考量，以及端詳。

m.x: We are considering several options.
m.xz: 我們正在考慮幾個方案。

m.x: She is considered one of the best interpreters in Asia.
m.xz: 她公認是亞洲頂尖的口譯員之一。

m.x: You should consider the costs first.

verbs.tip: 英文的 be considered 譯回中文時，可用「公認」「普遍認為」，避免直譯的翻譯腔。「列入考量」是 take into consideration。

verbs.core: 「繼續」：持續下去，或中斷之後接著做。

m.x: Prices are expected to continue rising.
After the break, the speaker continued.
m.xz: 休息過後，講者繼續發言。

m.x: She hopes to continue her studies abroad.
Let's continue this discussion tomorrow.

verbs.tip: 口說可用 go on 或 carry on 代替 continue：Please go on.（請繼續。）「持續成長」是 continue to grow，「待續」是 to be continued。

verbs.core: 「記得」：想起、記住，延伸為紀念（亡者）與代為問候。

m.x: I remember meeting her in Brussels.
m.xz: 我記得在布魯塞爾見過她。

m.x: Today we remember those who lost their lives.

verbs.tip: remember doing 是「記得做過」，remember to do 是「記得要去做」。追悼場合的「緬懷」用 remember，比 commemorate 有溫度。

verbs.core: 「站在下面去理解」：懂、明白，延伸為體諒對方，以及「據了解」。

m.x: Do you understand the question?
I understand your concerns.
I understand you're moving to Tokyo.

i: 大家心照不宣・據了解
讓別人聽懂自己的意思
verbs.tip: 談判中說 I understand your position. 是表示「理解」，不等於「同意」，口譯時要譯準。「據了解」可以說 I understand that… 或 We understand that…。
